subject: Coord: Fintegrate console + API enablement — pick final slot
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@fintegrate.co>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@fintegrate.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:23:00 -0400
Subject: Fintegrate console + API enablement — proposed slots

Hi Alex / Sara,

Great to meet you on the intro call earlier this week. As discussed, we want to run a combined console walkthrough + API enablement session (we'll cover console navigation, API keys & sandbox access, and a short hands-on lab for your engineering team).

Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue Sep 15 — 10:00–11:30
- Wed Sep 16 — 14:00–15:30
- Thu Sep 17 — 09:30–11:00

I've attached an updated agenda and a short preflight access checklist so your infra/identity folks can pre-provision accounts ahead of time. If none of the slots work, share 2–3 alternatives and we'll adapt.

I'll loop in our training lead to run the lab (Ben) and an infra engineer for live troubleshooting (Marcus) once you confirm the preferred time.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Attachments: fintegrate-enable-agenda-v2.pdf, preflight-access-checklist.txt

From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@fintegrate.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@fintegrate.co>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fintegrate console + API enablement — proposed slots

Thanks Naomi — all of these look reasonable. Quick notes: 1) Our engineering team would prefer a 60–75 minute focused session rather than 90 if possible (we can surface follow-ups separately). 2) We definitely need the API deep-dive (token scoping, KV cache behavior) — Sara will be our technical lead.

From our side, Wed Sep 16 at 14:00 ET is the best fit, but if you need a later start we'll try to accommodate. Also please confirm we get sandbox creds at least 48 hours before the session.

Best,
Alex Grant
Director, Integrations | Fintegrate
alex.grant@fintegrate.co

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@fintegrate.co>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@fintegrate.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fintegrate console + API enablement — proposed slots

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply, Alex.

Ben — can you lead the session? Alex asked for a tighter 60–75 minute format but wants the API deep-dive included (token scoping + KV/cache notes). I attached agenda v2 which trims the slides and pushes the hands-on lab into a focused 25–30 minute exercise.

Marcus — can you confirm whether Wed Sep 16 at 14:00 ET is feasible from a runtime/control-plane perspective? If not, what's the nearest 30–60 minute shift that keeps all stakeholder windows intact?

Alex / Sara — we'll aim to provision sandbox creds 48 hours prior; Jordan will send the meet link and the Drive folder with the lab notebook after we lock the time.

Thanks — Naomi

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Grant <alex.grant@fintegrate.co>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@fintegrate.co>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fintegrate console + API enablement — proposed slots

On Fri, Sep 11, 2026 at 11:45 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marcus — can you confirm whether Wed Sep 16 at 14:00 ET is feasible from a runtime/control-plane perspective?

Heads-up: we have a short maintenance window on Wed Sep 16 that overlaps 14:00–14:30 ET (rolling config push for a subset of Dedicated pools). I can be on the call, but to avoid any noisy background ops I'd prefer we shift the start to 14:30 ET or move to Thu morning (09:30 ET) if that helps. Either is fine from my side; if we must keep 14:00 I can make myself available but would like a 10m buffer at the top to validate node readiness.

If we go 14:30 ET, I'll preload a small demo snapshot that covers the same API flows so the customer experience isn't impacted even if there are brief infra ops.

—Marcus
Senior Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Grant <alex.grant@fintegrate.co>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@fintegrate.co>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fintegrate console + API enablement — proposed slots

14:30 ET on Wed Sep 16 works for me — I'll compress the walkthrough to a 70-minute plan: 25m console, 25m API deep-dive (token scopes + KV/cache), 20m hands-on lab + Q&A. I'll bring the runbook and step-by-step lab checklist.

Jordan — can you handle sending the sandbox creds and the Meet link once Naomi confirms? If you want, I'll add a 3-slide billing overview for context (customers sometimes ask about reserved vs. burst pricing during enablement).

Ben Carter
Principal Training Lead | Redwood Inference
Attachment: training-runbook-v1.docx (stub)
From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@fintegrate.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@fintegrate.co>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fintegrate console + API enablement — confirmed 14:30 ET

Thanks team — Wed Sep 16 at 14:30–15:40 ET is perfect. Please send the sandbox creds and meet link 48 hours beforehand (so by Mon Sep 14 end of day). We would also like the session recorded and a copy of the lab notebook after the run.

Naomi — can you confirm final meeting invite + attendees?

Appreciate the flexibility — Alex
